criticalAmbiguities.text: The public CLI catalog lists business management and business finance at 3 credits, while the 2022 Liberty guide lists BUS310/BUS320 at 4 source and 4 receiving credits. Do not match a current course to an archived award by title alone.
No CLI course ACE recommendation was established from National Guide or Credly primary records. Treat this route as institution-issued where documented, not as assumed ACE credit.
No receiving-school official CLI equivalency or acceptance evidence was located for TESU or UMPI in this bounded research. This is an evidence gap, not a demonstrated rejection.
Several listed partners recognize CLI bachelor's graduates for graduate admission. That cannot be represented as graduate transfer credits or a bachelor's exact course map.

Outgoing transcript processing is verified, but current transfer-only verification cost, required enrollments, course assessment/proctoring, and collegiate source-credit versions are not yet fully documented.

appFieldRecommendations.reason: Canonicalize CLI/CLC and preserve who actually issues the transcript, separately from a course platform or marketing brand.
Distinguish free developmental learning, Institute Verification, and degree-seeking LES admission.
Candidate/pre-accreditation and receiving-school treatment are time-dependent; neither implies regional accreditation.
Only populate ACE when supported by an actual recommendation; issuer credit and ACE credit must not collapse into one provider flag.
Represent free course access alongside verification/transcript/degree fees without hiding required costs or charging a degree fee per transfer course.

Maintain historical original vs receiving values and avoid the current 3-credit vs archived 4-credit mismatch. Some underlying curricula already preserve origin and source quantities; enforce these at catalog/provider ingestion too.
Course equivalency, transcript recognition, graduate admission, and tuition offers are different claims.
A source checked today can still publish a July 2022 mapping; checked date is not effective date.
Self-paced and low-cost alone do not establish nonproctored exams, adult/minor access, or a completion deadline.
